about.title: More Than Play. We Build the Way.
about.body: At Elite Pro Academy, we believe sports can shape more than physical strength—they can build confidence, resilience, discipline, and lifelong healthy habits. Through specialised programs, qualified coaches, and an inclusive environment, we help children grow into healthier, happier, and more confident individuals.

cta.title: Their Journey Starts Here.
cta.body: Give your child the space to discover, grow, and build a healthier future through sports.
